_source: Hand-worked in max-loan-template-v4.xlsx (A1-A4 from v3), case by case. Not derived from engine code.
_checkedBy: Independent script recomputation of every MSR/TDSR loan, tenure and age (matches to the cent)

_conventions.decision: NOTE ON AFFORDABILITY in evaluate.contract.js (#30); HDB rules from seat 2's review of #30 (HDB 'Housing loan from HDB' page)
_conventions.assessmentRate: Higher of the floor (loans.stressTestRate) and the loan rate. Bank loans: no bank rate in the model, so the floor.
_conventions.ageUsed: HDB loan: plain average of the applicants' ages. Bank loan: IWAA = sum(age x income) / sum(income). Both rounded UP to a whole year.
_conventions.tenure: Whole years. HDB: shortest of asked, maxTenureYears.hdbLoan, ageLimit - ageUsed, remainingLeaseYears - leaseBufferYears. Bank: shortest of asked and maxTenureYears.bankLoanHdbFlats.
_conventions.instalmentCapToLoan: cap x (1 - (1 + r)^-n) / r, r = assessmentRate / 12, n = tenureYears x 12; rounded to the nearest cent (halves up)
_conventions.ltv: HDB: maxPercent x factor, factor = max(0, 1 - percentPerYearShort / 100 x shortfall), shortfall = max(0, leaseMustCoverYoungestToAge - youngest age - remainingLeaseYears) (seat 2's derived assumption, #35). Bank: reducedMaxPercent if tenure > reducedIfTenureYearsOver OR IWAA + tenure > reducedIfLoanEndsAfterAge.
_conventions.maxLoan: Smallest of the MSR loan, the TDSR loan (bank only) and the LTV loan, ROUNDED DOWN to the whole dollar. limitingRule: MSR | TDSR | LTV.

_units: All money in integer cents. Rates and LTV as decimals.
_rulesetNote: Loan rules in ruleset shape, using seat 2's key names as agreed on #30 (loans.hdbLoanTenure, loans.stressTestRate, loans.ltv.hdbLoan.leaseMustCoverYoungestToAge, loans.ltv.hdbLoan.leaseProRating; values match seat 2's #35). Kept here so a ruleset update can't silently change these expected values.

cases.description: HDB loan, new flat: the MSR loan is above the LTV loan, so LTV binds.
HDB loan, new flat, lower income: MSR binds; the max loan is floored to the dollar.
Bank loan, 30 years: assessed at the 4% floor; IWAA 35.89 rounds up to 36; tenure 30 > 25 (and 36 + 30 > 65), so the reduced 55% LTV applies and binds.
cases._status: Final. The 4% bank floor is sourced (MAS 'Calculating TDSR', added by seat 2 in #35).

cases.description: HDB loan, ages 50 and 52: average age 51 caps tenure at 65 - 51 = 14 years, so MSR binds.

HDB loan, resale with 40 years left: the lease cap (40 - 20 = 20) sets tenure, and 30 + 40 = 70 < 95, so LTV is pro-rated. LTV binds under any pro-rating (unprorated LTV loan $262,500 < MSR loan $432,746.19).
cases._provenance: LTV rows worked by hand by seat 1 (25 years short: 75% x 50% = 37.5%; $350,000 x 37.5% = $131,250). Confirmed by sheet formulas in max-loan-template-v4 (column F, set up with Claude from the stated rules, not engine code) and by an independent exact recomputation.

cases.description: HDB loan, resale with 49 years left (athirah's #32 review): 30 + 49 = 79, 16 years short of 95, LTV binds. The decimal factor 75 x (1 - 0.02 x 16) is 50.99999999999999 in floats; worked in whole numbers the LTV loan must not lose $1.
cases._provenance: Worked by hand by seat 1 (16 years short: 75% x 68% = 51%; $350,000 x 51% = $178,500; MSR loan by the annuity formula). Confirmed by sheet formulas in max-loan-template-v4 (column G, set up with Claude from the stated rules, not engine code) and by an independent exact recomputation.
